title: Invite validation errors reach UI only as a global toast
answers: How do invite validation errors reach the UI?
Why is there no inline field error in the invite modal?
Where is the 'Invite team members failed' toast produced?
body:
- Backend: serializer errors/PermissionDenied → 4xx. In bulk, `first_bulk_invite_error` re-raises only the first failing row's errors as one ValidationError (per-row list would reach clients as a raw dict).
- Client: `api.create` throws `ApiError` (frontend/src/lib/api-error.ts:ApiError.fromResponse) copying detail/code/attr/status.
- Kea loader dispatches `inviteTeamMembersFailure`; inviteLogic has NO failure listener and no inline field errors. The global handler is frontend/src/initKea.ts `loadersPlugin({onFailure})`: ignores AbortError, skips statuses 200/201/204/401/409, shows `lemonToast.error("Invite team members failed: <detail||statusText>")` (prefix via identifierToHuman of action name); 429 rewritten to "Rate limit exceeded..." (throttles OrganizationInviteBurstThrottle 50/hour and Sustained in posthog/rate_limit.py, only create/bulk); suppressed for 2FA/sensitive_action_required_reauth codes; 400 with code verified_domain_required must keep generic toast (only 403 gets dedicated apiStatusLogic toast).
- Not verified: the DRF exception handler's exact 400 JSON shape.
says: Why don't I see inline field errors when bulk invites fail?
Where do invite validation errors appear to the user in the interface?
How come the invite modal only shows a toast, not field-level errors?
What determines how invite validation errors reach the user interface?
Why is the invite failure message only a toast notification, not inline?
search: Invite validation errors from backend serializer/PermissionDenied (4xx) are converted by first_bulk_invite_error to a single ValidationError (first row only) and reach the client as ApiError via frontend/src/lib/api-error.ts:ApiError.fromResponse. inviteLogic has no failure listener and no inline field error handlers; errors surface only via the global handler in frontend/src/initKea.ts loadersPlugin.onFailure, which shows lemonToast.error() with the error detail. Status 429 is rewritten to "Rate limit exceeded" (OrganizationInviteBurstThrottle 50/hour); verified_domain_required 400 errors keep generic toast; 403 gets dedicated apiStatusLogic toast. Applies to modifying invite error UX, adding field-level validation, and handling rate limiting.
